senses.gloss: शंव a. Happy, fortunate.

शंव + .{@-वः@}
—1 Ploughing in the regular direction.
—2 The thunderbolt of Indra.
—3 The iron head of a pestle.

संवत् ind.

—2 Especially a year of the Vikramāditya era (commencing 56 years before

—2 A year of Vikramādityaʼs era.
—3 N. of Śiva. —4 The first year in the cycle of five years.

—2 An almanac-maker.
—3 A lunar month.
—4 Black rice.

संवत्सरः + -भ्रमि a. revolving
[]

संवत्सरः + -रयः a yearʼs course.

—4 To name, call.
—5 To agree, accord, consent.
—6 To coincide, fit together (so as to give one sense). ━Caus.
—1 To consult, hold consultation (with instr.); as in मौहूर्तिकैः सह संवाद्यताम्.
